name: loadscreen-builder
description: Visual builder for FiveM loading screens: a Tauri desktop app + an overextended-style TypeScript resource.

scripts.desktop:dev: cd apps/desktop && bun run tauri dev
scripts.desktop:build: cd apps/desktop && bun run tauri build
scripts.typecheck: cd apps/fivem-resource && bun run typecheck && tsc --noEmit -p ../../packages/shared && tsc --noEmit -p ../../packages/resource-generator && cd ../../apps/desktop && bun run typecheck
